assignment.rule: deterministic hash of the slug, so a market's arm never changes between sessions or across a restart -- a market that flips arms mid-residual would be neither arm
assignment.why_not_random_per_session: a residual can span sessions after a restart. Randomising per session would let the same held position be worked under both arms and belong to neither.
assignment.why_not_alternate_by_time: sports liquidity has a time-of-day shape; alternating by clock would confound the arm with the slate.

new_bounds_required.why: a rejected complete at a non-crossing price revokes the complement proof, which is the deadlock that took the lane down at 13:09 on 2026-09-08. Re-quoting must not buy fills by spending proofs.

primary_endpoint.name: realized dollars per capital-dollar-hour, treat minus control
primary_endpoint.why_not_completion_rate: the offline replay says two thirds of these completions are ABOVE PAR. A completion-rate endpoint would score locked losses as wins, which is the exact failure this whole analysis exists to avoid.
secondary: residual units carried to settlement per settled market
pair cost distribution, and the share above par
complete rejections per session, treated arm only

stop_early.why: these are safety stops, not efficacy reads. Hitting one halts the treated arm and leaves control running.

non_contamination.mechanism: every session_end row carries requote_arm. The extension evaluator counts CONTROL-arm sessions only, so L5_COMPLETION_EXTENSION_GATE_v1's baselines, criteria and sample minimums are untouched.
non_contamination.cost: the extension accrues evidence at roughly half rate: its remaining ~20 firings move from about 5 forward hours to about 10.
non_contamination.what_would_break_it: an unlabelled session. A session_end row without an arm field must be counted in NEITHER arm and must be reported, never defaulted to control -- defaulting would silently feed treated sessions into the extension's evidence.
non_contamination.the_gate_is_not_edited: L5_COMPLETION_EXTENSION_GATE_v1 keeps its frozen sha. This design changes what the evaluator COUNTS, never what the gate REQUIRES.

authorisation.arming_requires: an explicit owner go, naming the arm split and the stop conditions. PMUS_SPRING_COMPLETE_REQUOTE defaults OFF and no code here sets it.
